removed.t: CRH faces risks associated with the relocation of our primary listing.
On September 25, 2023, CRH relocated the primary listing of its ordinary shares from the LSE to the NYSE.
Following the transition to the NYSE, CRH has been added to the MSCI USA Equity Index, the S&P TMI Index and the Russell 1000 Equity Index.
